parameters.content:
## Mock Booking — Full Workflow (v2)

**Submit flow:**
Webhook POST → Validate → Check Slot → Flag Booked → Append MOCK_INTERVIEW_BOOKING → Notify Sam → 200 OK

**Confirm/Reject flow (v2 — race condition safe):**
Sam tap link → Parse (id, action, skip_free) → Read Booking → Read CONFIG → Build Data →
Already Processed? →
  TRUE  → Already Processed HTML
  FALSE → Read Bookings Same Slot → Check Slot Conflict → Slot Conflict? →
    TRUE  → Slot Conflict HTML (+ tombol Tolak Duplikat dengan skip_free=1)
    FALSE → Confirm or Reject? →
      confirm → Update Confirmed → Send WA Payment → Confirm HTML
      reject  → Update Rejected → Should Free Slot? →
                  TRUE  → Free Slot → Send WA Rejection → Reject HTML
                  FALSE → Send WA Rejection → Reject HTML  (skip_free=1: tidak bebaskan slot milik booking lain)

**Race condition handling:**
- Jika 2 booking ada utk slot yg sama (keduanya Pending), Sam konfirmasi satu → booking lainnya akan
  menampilkan halaman 'Jadwal Sudah Di-book' dgn info peserta yg dikonfirmasi.
- Sam bisa klik 'Tolak Booking Duplikat' → reject tanpa membebaskan slot (skip_free=1).
- Jika Sam menolak booking pertama dulu → slot dibebaskan → booking kedua available utk di-confirm/reject.

**Sheet columns MOCK_INTERVIEW_BOOKING:**
ID Booking | Tanggal | Jam Mulai | Jam Selesai | Sesi | Slot ID | Nama Anak | Nama Orang Tua | No WA Anak | Asal Kota | Sekolah | Kelas | Kurikulum Sekolah | Target Uni Jurusan | Bimbingan | Status | Catatan Sam | Timestamp

**Sheet CONFIG:**
Key | Value
NOMINAL_BIAYA | 1.000.000
NAMA_BANK | BCA
NOMOR_REKENING | 1820111111
ATAS_NAMA | Samuel Oscar
DEADLINE_HARI | 1
